caption: The drawing depicts a light-colored bonnet, predominantly in beige, with a wide brim and a decorative ribbon encircling the crown and hanging in long, textured streamers at the back. The underside of the brim features a detailed floral pattern composed of pink, red, and white flowers with green leaves and brown stems. The bonnet is presented in a three-quarters view, showing both the side and the inside of the brim. Below and to the right of the main image, there are two smaller, simple line sketches showing the bonnet from a top and back view, respectively, without any color or shading. The background is a plain, lightly yellowed paper, with some noticeable brownish stains and marks along the edges.
title: Wedding Bonnet
